title: Harbor and Ledger
author: Zephyrine Brightwater
blurb: Mara Kavanagh, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
